findings.name: Admin bypass of required reviews (enforce_admins disabled)
bypass_path: 1. Attacker has repo-admin privileges on AcmeFintech/payment-api
2. Branch protection on 'main' has enforce_admins=false
3. Admin pushes directly to main, bypassing required review
4. GitHub Actions workflow triggers on push to main
5. Workflow assumes AWS ProdDeployRole via OIDC

findings.name: Workflows can approve their own PRs
bypass_path: 1. Attacker has repo-write privileges
2. Creates PR with malicious workflow changes
3. GitHub Actions bot auto-approves via GITHUB_TOKEN
4. PR merges to main with bot approval counting
5. Malicious workflow executes and assumes ProdDeployRole

findings.name: pull_request_target + PR head checkout (supply chain attack)
bypass_path: 1. EXTERNAL attacker forks AcmeFintech/infra-terraform
2. Modifies workflow to exfiltrate OIDC token
3. Opens PR against main branch
4. Workflow uses pull_request_target and checks out PR head
5. Attacker's code runs in the context of the base repo
6. OIDC token issued for AcmeFintech/infra-terraform
7. Token assumes InfraProvisionRole (wildcard branch OIDC claim)

findings.name: Production environment with no required reviewers
bypass_path: 1. Attacker has repo-write privileges on db-migrations
2. Production environment has zero required reviewers
3. Workflow targeting production environment runs without approval
4. Assumes ProdDBMigrationRole via OIDC environment claim
